description: Presidential Secretariat - Appoint Mr. Anusha Palpita as Secretary to the Ministry of Economic Policies & Plan Implementation - Appointments Mr. M. N. Ranasinghe as Secretary to the State Minister of Promoting the Production & Regulations the Supply of Organic Fertilizer and Paddy and etc. and Mr. L. L. A. Wijesiri as Secretary to the State Minister of Coast Conservation & Low Lying Lands Development
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (Mr. Anusha Palpita, Mr. M. N. Ranasinghe, Mr. L. L. A Wijesiri) AND detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities (e.g., "Secretary to the Ministry of Economic Policies & Plan Implementation," "State Ministry of Promoting the Production & Regulating the Supply of Organic Fertilizer..."). This combination of "who" (government personnel) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities) meets the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
